item.title: 35-year-old teacher finally passes LET after 17 attempts
item.description: MANILA, Philippines – Roland John R. Visco of Tagaytay City carries a story that proves perseverance can endure years of failure and still lead to fulfillment. Photo courtesy: Roland John Visco Beginning in 2015, Visco repeatedly faced the Licensure Examination for Teachers (LET), taking it a total of seventeen times before finally earning the license he had pursued for nearly a decade.
